description.root: PokéNerdle is a Pokémon-themed web game packed with fun, challenge, and evolving game modes. Play solo or with friends and prove you're a true Pokénerd!
description.daily: Play the Daily Challenge and test your Pokémon knowledge! Guess the daily mystery Pokémon in 8 tries or less!
description.archive: Browse past PokéNerdle Daily Challenges and replay any day you missed.
description.statGuesser: Guess the Pokemon by its stats in this PokéNerdle challenge.
description.pokechain: Build a chain of Pokemon connections in PokéNerdle.
description.pathFinder: Connect two Pokemon through shared traits in PokéNerdle.
